mfa_factors_totp_has_secret.name: mfa_factors_totp_has_secret
mfa_factors_totp_has_secret.value: "mfa_factors"."type" <> 'totp' OR ("mfa_factors"."totp_secret" IS NOT NULL AND "mfa_factors"."webauthn_credential_id" IS NULL)

mfa_factors_webauthn_has_credential.name: mfa_factors_webauthn_has_credential
mfa_factors_webauthn_has_credential.value: "mfa_factors"."type" <> 'webauthn' OR ("mfa_factors"."webauthn_credential_id" IS NOT NULL AND "mfa_factors"."webauthn_public_key" IS NOT NULL AND "mfa_factors"."webauthn_counter" IS NOT NULL AND "mfa_factors"."totp_secret" IS NULL)

report_actions_actor_valid.name: report_actions_actor_valid
report_actions_actor_valid.value:
("report_actions"."actor_type" = 'system' and "report_actions"."actor_id" is null)
        or ("report_actions"."actor_type" = 'user' and "report_actions"."actor_id" ~ '^usr_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{26}$')
        or ("report_actions"."actor_type" = 'api_key' and "report_actions"."actor_id" ~ '^key_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{26}$')

reports_due_idx.name: reports_due_idx
reports_due_idx.where: "reports"."next_run_at" is not null and "reports"."paused_at" is null and "reports"."redacted_at" is null
